notes.note: Methuss trails off mid-sentence ('I'm...'); kept unfinished as in source.
Narration; source says the Weather Dopant 'vanished/was erased'; rendered 'gone'. Methuss g=f per glossary.
Rows 0.105-0.108 and 0.111-0.119 are two branches: Den-O already holding the spare Pass vs. arriving late and receiving it from the player.
'flow of time' as established in story_007 for the Den-O term.
Extractor labels this Kintaros, but it is Ryutaros's line (parallel row 0.119 has Ryutaros, and Kintaros just spoke in 0.107). Rendered in Ryutaros's voice.
Subject 'I': Accel alone defeated Weather Dopant in the previous scene, so 'I won', not 'we'.
Source retort 'there's no what-happened about it'; rendered 'Whaddaya mean, what happened!?'. Avoided 'Don't ask' to not collide with Accel's catchphrase.
Direction: Ryutaros asking the heroes to treat the Imagin well ('Be nice to us'), answering Momotaros's 'we'll be leaning on you again'.
Shotaro's casual reply to the Imagin's request rendered 'welcome aboard'; 0.156-0.160 are party-leader variants answering with 'likewise'.
OOO calls Rider 1 and 2 'senpai'; rendered 'our sempai Rider 1 and Rider 2' (spelling per glossary 'Sempai'). Mebius's polite '-san' (0.160) dropped.
proofread: glossary keeps 'Sempai' for the Imagin addressing Momotaros only; OOO's senpai for Rider 1/2 -> 'our seniors', as in other slices.
'Likewise, we're counting on you too!' = Mebius returning the request for goodwill (both sides asking each other).

Rows 0.167-0.179 are the Ankh-led branch with no recovered speakers: 0.167/0.169/0.170/0.174 Accel, 0.173/0.175 Momotaros, 0.176-0.177 Urataros, 0.178 Kintaros, 0.179 Ryutaros (inferred from parallel rows 0.127-0.154).
Ankh to Accel; grudging praise, kept short.
Differs from 0.135: here the lost powers are 'sleeping all over this world'.
Unidentified villain (???) monologue; no gender assumed.

Rows 0.197-0.203 have no recovered speakers. Inferred from speech style: 0.197 Momotaros (rough), 0.198 Urataros (drawling), 0.199 Kintaros (Kansai), 0.200 Ryutaros (childish), 0.201 likely Momotaros, 0.202 Urataros. 'That bastard' is probably Negataros (or Weather Dopant).
Villain's chuckle, likely Weather Dopant (next slice opens with the party shouting 'Weather Dopant!!' and Weather's lines); laugh styled as in story_004.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers inferred for unlabeled rows 0.167-0.179 (Ankh branch, from parallel rows) and 0.197-0.203 (Den-O Imagin by voice, villain laugh). 0.108 mislabeled Kintaros, treated as Ryutaros. OOO's 'senpai' for Rider 1/2 rendered 'our sempai'. Terms not in glossary: Trial Memory, spare (Rider) Pass, 'flow of time' (all as used in earlier slices / Kamen Rider canon).
